method: LLVM release O2 standalone native processes; one warm-up each, then alternating order. Duration includes process launch and scope-exit destruction. Three independent runs are retained in repeat_medians_ms; per-run samples are in rows.
interpreter_note: tree/interp destruction is measured by /tmp-style wall-clock of `tools/cool run` on the shallow program (includes frontend compile); the interpreter recursion fast path reduced it from ~1.34x/1.24x to ~1.18x/1.19x.
